Daily life|Advanced.example: Da pendolare passo due ore al giorno in treno.
Daily life|Advanced.meaning: a person who travels daily between home and work
Daily life|Advanced.translation: As a commuter I spend two hours a day on the train.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Torno a casa alle sei di sera.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I get home at six in the evening.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Ogni mattina compro il pane fresco al forno.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: a basic food made from flour and baked
Daily life|Beginner.translation: Every morning I buy fresh bread at the bakery.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Vorrei una bottiglia di acqua naturale, per favore.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I would like a bottle of still water, please.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Bevo un bicchiere di latte prima di dormire.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: the white drink that comes from cows
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I drink a glass of milk before going to sleep.

Daily life|Beginner.example: La mamma prepara la cena in cucina.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: Mum is making dinner in the kitchen.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Mio papà lavora in un ufficio vicino alla stazione.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: My dad works in an office near the station.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Mio fratello ha due anni meno di me.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: My brother is two years younger than me.

Daily life|Beginner.example: La cucina è piccola ma molto luminosa.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: the room where food is prepared
Daily life|Beginner.translation: The kitchen is small but very bright.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Vado a letto presto perché domani lavoro.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I go to bed early because I work tomorrow.

Daily life|Beginner.example: A colazione mangio un cornetto e bevo un caffè.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: the first meal of the day
Daily life|Beginner.translation: For breakfast I eat a croissant and drink a coffee.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Stasera la cena è pronta alle otto.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: Tonight dinner is ready at eight.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Vado al supermercato a comprare frutta e verdura.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: a large shop that sells food and household goods
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I am going to the supermarket to buy fruit and vegetables.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Non ho abbastanza soldi per questa giacca.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I do not have enough money for this jacket.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Il mio lavoro inizia alle nove del mattino.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: My job starts at nine in the morning.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Oggi fa freddo, mettiti il cappotto.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: It is cold today, put your coat on.

Daily life|Beginner.example: In agosto fa molto caldo in città.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: In August it is very hot in the city.

Daily life|Beginner.example: La pioggia non smette da questa mattina.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: The rain has not stopped since this morning.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Sono stanco dopo una giornata così lunga.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I am tired after such a long day.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Sono contento di vederti dopo tanto tempo.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I am happy to see you after such a long time.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Domani ho un appuntamento dal medico alle dieci.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: a person trained to treat illness
Daily life|Beginner.translation: Tomorrow I have an appointment at the doctor's at ten.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Stendo il bucato sul balcone quando c'è il sole.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: clothes that are being washed or have just been washed
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: I hang the laundry out on the balcony when it is sunny.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Il sabato mattina sbrigo tutte le faccende di casa.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the everyday jobs that keep a house running
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: On Saturday mornings I get all the household chores done.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Faccio la spesa il giovedì per evitare la fila.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the food shopping you do for the house
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: I do the grocery shopping on Thursdays to avoid the queue.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Conserva lo scontrino se vuoi cambiare le scarpe.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the small printed proof of a purchase
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: Keep the receipt if you want to exchange the shoes.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Su questi pantaloni c'è uno sconto del trenta per cento.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: a reduction in the price of something
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: There is a thirty percent discount on these trousers.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: La bolletta della luce è arrivata più alta del solito.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the bill you pay for gas, water or electricity
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: The electricity bill came in higher than usual.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: L'affitto scade il primo giorno di ogni mese.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the money paid every month to live in a home
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: The rent is due on the first day of every month.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: La riunione di condominio è fissata per giovedì sera.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: a shared apartment building and its residents
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: The residents' meeting is set for Thursday evening.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Ho messo la sveglia alle sei per non fare tardi.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the alarm that wakes you up
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: I set the alarm for six so I would not be late.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Dopo pranzo mi concedo sempre un pisolino di venti minuti.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: a short sleep during the day
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: After lunch I always allow myself a twenty minute nap.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Mia nonna mi ha dato la ricetta del ragù.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: instructions for cooking a dish, or a doctor's prescription
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: My grandmother gave me the recipe for meat sauce.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Vuoi assaggiare la torta che ho appena sfornato?
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: to taste a small amount of food
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: Do you want to taste the cake I have just taken out of the oven?

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Stasera scaldiamo gli avanzi di ieri invece di cucinare.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: food left over from an earlier meal
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: Tonight let's heat up yesterday's leftovers instead of cooking.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Ho preso il raffreddore stando fuori senza sciarpa.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: a mild illness with a blocked or runny nose
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: I caught a cold from being outside without a scarf.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: La farmacia sotto casa resta aperta fino a mezzanotte.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the shop where medicines are sold
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: The pharmacy downstairs stays open until midnight.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Il trasloco ci ha portato via tutto il fine settimana.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the act of moving your things to a new home
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: The move took up our entire weekend.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: I vicini di sopra fanno rumore fino a tardi.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the people who live next to you
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: The neighbours upstairs make noise until late.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Non posso venire, ho già un impegno domani sera.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: something you have committed to do
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: I cannot come, I already have a commitment tomorrow evening.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Bere un tè la sera è ormai un'abitudine per me.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: something you do regularly without thinking
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: Drinking tea in the evening has become a habit for me.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Il cielo è nuvoloso, forse è meglio portare l'ombrello.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: with the sky covered by clouds
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: The sky is cloudy, maybe it is better to take an umbrella.

IELTS|Advanced.example: Si osserva un notevole calo delle iscrizioni dopo il 2015.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: large enough to be worth noticing
IELTS|Advanced.translation: A notable drop in enrolments can be seen after 2015.

IELTS|Advanced.example: I dati del nord sono in netto contrasto con quelli del sud.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: in sharp contrast
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The figures for the north stand in sharp contrast with those for the south.

IELTS|Advanced.example: Il calo è dovuto presumibilmente all'aumento del costo della vita.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: probably, judging from the evidence
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The decline is presumably due to the rising cost of living.

IELTS|Advanced.example: Le famiglie più giovani tendenzialmente spendono di più in tecnologia.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: generally, as a tendency
IELTS|Advanced.translation: Younger households generally spend more on technology.

IELTS|Advanced.example: L'incidenza dell'affitto sul reddito è cresciuta in tutte le regioni.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: how often something occurs or how much it weighs
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The share of income taken up by rent has grown in every region.

IELTS|Advanced.example: Il divario tra stipendi maschili e femminili resta ampio.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: a wide gap between two groups or figures
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The gap between men's and women's salaries remains wide.

IELTS|Advanced.example: Il mercato ha mostrato una forte fluttuazione nei mesi estivi.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: an irregular rise and fall in a value
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The market showed sharp fluctuation during the summer months.

IELTS|Advanced.example: Le vendite hanno raggiunto il picco nel dicembre del 2019.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: the highest point on a graph
IELTS|Advanced.translation: Sales reached their peak in December 2019.

IELTS|Advanced.example: Dopo il 2020 i prezzi sembrano stabilizzarsi intorno ai valori attuali.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: to stop changing and stay level
IELTS|Advanced.translation: After 2020 prices appear to level off around their current values.

IELTS|Advanced.example: Il sondaggio non è del tutto attendibile perché il campione è piccolo.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: reliable and worth trusting
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The survey is not entirely reliable because the sample is small.

IELTS|Advanced.example: Si può ipotizzare che il clima abbia influito sul raccolto.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: to suggest something as a possible explanation
IELTS|Advanced.translation: One might hypothesise that the weather affected the harvest.

IELTS|Advanced.example: Nuove politiche potrebbero attenuare l'impatto della crisi sulle famiglie.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: to reduce the force or effect of something
IELTS|Advanced.translation: New policies could soften the impact of the crisis on families.

IELTS|Advanced.example: L'obiettivo è incrementare la quota di energia pulita entro il 2030.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: to raise a quantity or level
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The aim is to raise the share of clean energy by 2030.

IELTS|Advanced.example: La sua presa di posizione sul lavoro minorile ha sorpreso molti.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: a clear stand taken on an issue
IELTS|Advanced.translation: Her stand on child labour surprised many people.

IELTS|Advanced.example: I benefici di questa riforma si vedranno solo a lungo termine.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: over a long period into the future
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The benefits of this reform will only be seen in the long term.

IELTS|Advanced.example: Gli affitti sono saliti e di conseguenza molti giovani sono usciti dal centro.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: as a result of that
IELTS|Advanced.translation: Rents went up and as a result many young people moved out of the centre.

IELTS|Advanced.example: In definitiva, i costi superano ancora i benefici del progetto.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: in the end; all things considered
IELTS|Advanced.translation: All things considered, the costs still outweigh the benefits of the project.

IELTS|Advanced.example: La sostenibilità del sistema pensionistico preoccupa gli economisti.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: the quality of lasting without harming resources
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The sustainability of the pension system worries economists.

IELTS|Advanced.example: L'effetto della nuova tassa sui consumi è stato trascurabile.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: so small it can be ignored
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The effect of the new tax on spending was negligible.

IELTS|Advanced.example: Questi risultati sembrano mettere in discussione le conclusioni dello studio precedente.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: to question or challenge an idea
IELTS|Advanced.translation: These results seem to call into question the conclusions of the previous study.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Il grafico mostra quante persone usano il treno ogni giorno.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a chart or diagram showing data
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The chart shows how many people use the train every day.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Il numero di studenti stranieri è molto alto quest'anno.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a figure used for counting
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The number of foreign students is very high this year.

IELTS|Beginner.example: C'è stato un aumento dei prezzi del cibo la scorsa estate.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a rise in amount or level
IELTS|Beginner.translation: There was a rise in food prices last summer.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Ti faccio un esempio semplice per spiegare il problema.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: something used to explain an idea
IELTS|Beginner.translation: Let me give you a simple example to explain the problem.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Il traffico in centro è un problema per tutti gli abitanti.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a difficult situation that needs a solution
IELTS|Beginner.translation: Traffic downtown is a problem for all the residents.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Molta gente preferisce lavorare da casa il venerdì.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: people in general
IELTS|Beginner.translation: A lot of people prefer to work from home on Fridays.

IELTS|Beginner.example: La mia città è diventata più pulita negli ultimi anni.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a large town where many people live
IELTS|Beginner.translation: My city has become cleaner in recent years.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Ho trovato un lavoro vicino a casa mia.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a job or the activity of working
IELTS|Beginner.translation: I found a job close to my house.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Lo studio delle lingue richiede molta pazienza.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: the act of learning a subject
IELTS|Beginner.translation: Studying languages requires a lot of patience.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Per me è importante dormire almeno otto ore.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: having a big effect or value
IELTS|Beginner.translation: For me it is important to sleep at least eight hours.

IELTS|Beginner.example: C'è una grande differenza tra i due quartieri della città.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: the way two things are not the same
IELTS|Beginner.translation: There is a big difference between the two neighbourhoods of the city.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Secondo me la scuola dovrebbe iniziare più tardi.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: in my opinion
IELTS|Beginner.translation: In my opinion school should start later.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Prendo la bici perché il parcheggio costa troppo.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: for the reason that
IELTS|Beginner.translation: I take my bike because parking costs too much.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Mi piace il film, però è un po' troppo lungo.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: but; used to add a contrast
IELTS|Beginner.translation: I like the film, but it is a little too long.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Vorrei cambiare città dopo l'università.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: to make or become different
IELTS|Beginner.translation: I would like to move to a different city after university.

IELTS|Beginner.example: I giovani tendono a spendere molto per il telefono.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: to use money to buy something
IELTS|Beginner.translation: Young people tend to spend a lot on their phones.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Camminare ogni giorno fa bene alla salute.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: the condition of your body
IELTS|Beginner.translation: Walking every day is good for your health.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Le auto elettriche aiutano l'ambiente in città.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: the natural world around us
IELTS|Beginner.translation: Electric cars help the environment in cities.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Studiare all'estero è stata una bella esperienza.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: something you have lived or done
IELTS|Beginner.translation: Studying abroad was a great experience.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Mi piace viaggiare, soprattutto in primavera.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: above all; mainly
IELTS|Beginner.translation: I like travelling, above all in spring.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Negli ultimi dieci anni c'è una chiara tendenza verso il lavoro da remoto.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: a general direction of change
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Over the last ten years there has been a clear trend towards remote work.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: La percentuale di laureati è cresciuta lentamente dal 2010.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: an amount expressed out of a hundred
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The percentage of graduates has grown slowly since 2010.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: I consumi di carne cominciano a diminuire tra i giovani.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: to become smaller or fewer
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Meat consumption is starting to fall among young people.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Il grafico mostra una crescita costante del turismo estivo.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: an increase over time
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The chart shows steady growth in summer tourism.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: La media delle ore di studio è di tre al giorno.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: the average value of a set of numbers
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The average number of study hours is three a day.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: I prezzi sono più bassi rispetto a quelli della capitale.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: compared with
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Prices are lower compared with those in the capital.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Non è una perdita di tempo; al contrario, aiuta molto.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: on the contrary; the opposite is true
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: It is not a waste of time; on the contrary, it helps a lot.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Il corso è gratuito; inoltre, offre un certificato finale.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: in addition; furthermore
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The course is free; in addition, it offers a final certificate.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: La proposta è interessante; tuttavia, costa troppo.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: however; despite that
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The proposal is interesting; however, it costs too much.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Il principale vantaggio della bicicletta è il costo basso.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: a good point or benefit
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The main advantage of cycling is the low cost.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Lo svantaggio di vivere in centro è il rumore.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: a bad point or drawback
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The drawback of living downtown is the noise.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Molti esperti continuano a sostenere che le tasse universitarie siano troppo alte.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: to support an idea or argument
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Many experts continue to maintain that university fees are too high.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: La pubblicità può influenzare le scelte dei consumatori.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: to have an effect on something
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Advertising can influence consumers' choices.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Dobbiamo confrontare i dati dei due paesi prima di decidere.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: to look at two things side by side
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: We need to compare the data from the two countries before deciding.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Una ricerca recente collega il sonno ai risultati scolastici.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: a careful study of a subject
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Recent research links sleep to school results.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Il governo dovrebbe investire più risorse nei trasporti pubblici.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: materials or money available for use
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The government should invest more resources in public transport.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Lo sviluppo delle energie rinnovabili crea nuovi posti di lavoro.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: the process of growing or improving
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The development of renewable energy creates new jobs.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: L'istruzione gratuita riduce le differenze tra le famiglie.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: the system of teaching and learning
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Free education reduces the gaps between families.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: In generale, le persone dormono meno di dieci anni fa.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: speaking broadly; usually
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Generally speaking, people sleep less than they did ten years ago.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Leggere prima di dormire è una buona abitudine.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: something you do regularly
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Reading before bed is a good habit.

Travel|Advanced.example: Abbiamo rivisto l'itinerario per includere la costa.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: the planned route of a journey
Travel|Advanced.translation: We revised the itinerary to include the coast.

Travel|Advanced.example: Preferiamo pernottare in un agriturismo fuori città.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: to spend the night somewhere
Travel|Advanced.translation: We'd rather spend the night at a farmhouse outside town.

Travel|Advanced.example: Il nostro soggiorno in Puglia si è rivelato indimenticabile.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: a period of staying in a place
Travel|Advanced.translation: Our stay in Puglia turned out to be unforgettable.

Travel|Advanced.example: Le Dolomiti restano la meta preferita degli escursionisti.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: a destination you aim to reach
Travel|Advanced.translation: The Dolomites are still hikers' favorite destination.

Travel|Advanced.example: Ad agosto l'affluenza turistica raggiunge il picco.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: a large flow of visitors to a place
Travel|Advanced.translation: In August the flow of tourists reaches its peak.

Travel|Advanced.example: Il cambio di data comporta un sovrapprezzo di cinquanta euro.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: an extra charge added to the base price
Travel|Advanced.translation: Changing the date involves a surcharge of fifty euros.

Travel|Advanced.example: Ho richiesto il rimborso del biglietto cancellato.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: money paid back to you
Travel|Advanced.translation: I requested a refund for the cancelled ticket.

Travel|Advanced.example: Siamo stati costretti a disdire la prenotazione all'ultimo momento.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: to cancel a booking formally
Travel|Advanced.translation: We were forced to cancel the booking at the last moment.

Travel|Advanced.example: Da pendolare conosco a memoria gli orari dei treni.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: a person who travels daily between home and work
Travel|Advanced.translation: As a commuter I know the train timetables by heart.

Travel|Advanced.example: Ho denunciato lo smarrimento del bagaglio all'ufficio reclami.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: the loss of luggage or documents
Travel|Advanced.translation: I reported the loss of my luggage at the complaints office.

Travel|Advanced.example: Il volo per Tokyo prevede uno scalo a Dubai.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: a stopover on a longer journey
Travel|Advanced.translation: The flight to Tokyo has a stopover in Dubai.

Travel|Advanced.example: L'escursione in montagna è stata rinviata per il maltempo.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: a short organized trip or hike
Travel|Advanced.translation: The mountain excursion was postponed because of bad weather.

Travel|Advanced.example: Ci siamo fermati in un borgo medievale sperduto tra le colline.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: a small old village, often on a hill
Travel|Advanced.translation: We stopped in a medieval village lost among the hills.

Travel|Advanced.example: Viaggiare fuori stagione costa molto meno.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: outside the busy tourist period
Travel|Advanced.translation: Travelling off-season costs a lot less.

Travel|Advanced.example: La prossima tappa del nostro giro è Siena.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: one leg or stop of a journey
Travel|Advanced.translation: The next stop on our tour is Siena.

Travel|Advanced.example: Il vettore aereo rifiuta ogni responsabilità per il ritardo.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: the company that carries passengers
Travel|Advanced.translation: The airline refuses any responsibility for the delay.

Travel|Advanced.example: La tariffa più economica è vincolante e non rimborsabile.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: binding, impossible to change without cost
Travel|Advanced.translation: The cheapest fare is binding and non-refundable.

Travel|Advanced.example: Ci scusiamo per il disagio causato ai passeggeri dallo sciopero.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: inconvenience or disruption to travelers
Travel|Advanced.translation: We apologize for the inconvenience the strike has caused passengers.

Travel|Advanced.example: In alta stagione le calli di Venezia sembrano brulicare di turisti.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: to swarm with people
Travel|Advanced.translation: In high season the alleys of Venice seem to swarm with tourists.

Travel|Advanced.example: Il periodo più gettonato per visitare la Toscana è maggio.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: very popular and much chosen
Travel|Advanced.translation: The most popular time to visit Tuscany is May.

Travel|Beginner.example: Il viaggio in treno dura tre ore.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a trip or journey
Travel|Beginner.translation: The train trip takes three hours.

Travel|Beginner.example: Arriviamo in aeroporto due ore prima del volo.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: the place where planes take off and land
Travel|Beginner.translation: We get to the airport two hours before the flight.

Travel|Beginner.example: Il volo per Roma parte alle otto.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a journey by plane
Travel|Beginner.translation: The flight to Rome leaves at eight.

Travel|Beginner.example: Prendo il treno delle sette ogni mattina.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a vehicle that travels on rails
Travel|Beginner.translation: I take the seven o'clock train every morning.

Travel|Beginner.example: La stazione è vicina all'albergo.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: the place where trains stop
Travel|Beginner.translation: The station is near the hotel.

Travel|Beginner.example: Ho comprato un biglietto di andata e ritorno.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a ticket for travel or entry
Travel|Beginner.translation: I bought a round-trip ticket.

Travel|Beginner.example: La mia valigia è troppo pesante.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a suitcase for clothes and things
Travel|Beginner.translation: My suitcase is too heavy.

Travel|Beginner.example: Non trovo più il mio passaporto.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: the official document you need to travel abroad
Travel|Beginner.translation: I can't find my passport anymore.

Travel|Beginner.example: Dormiamo in un albergo vicino al mare.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a hotel where travelers sleep
Travel|Beginner.translation: We are sleeping in a hotel near the sea.

Travel|Beginner.example: Vorrei una camera doppia per due notti.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a room, especially in a hotel
Travel|Beginner.translation: I would like a double room for two nights.

Travel|Beginner.example: L'autobus per il centro passa ogni dieci minuti.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a large public road vehicle for many people
Travel|Beginner.translation: The bus to the center comes every ten minutes.

Travel|Beginner.example: Andiamo al lago in macchina.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a car
Travel|Beginner.translation: We are going to the lake by car.

Travel|Beginner.example: Guarda la mappa, il museo è qui.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a drawing that shows streets and places
Travel|Beginner.translation: Look at the map, the museum is here.

Travel|Beginner.example: Firenze è una città bellissima.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a large place where many people live
Travel|Beginner.translation: Florence is a very beautiful city.

Travel|Beginner.example: D'estate andiamo sempre al mare.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: the sea
Travel|Beginner.translation: In summer we always go to the seaside.

Travel|Beginner.example: Quest'anno vado in vacanza in Sicilia.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: time away from work for rest or travel
Travel|Beginner.translation: This year I'm going on holiday to Sicily.

Travel|Beginner.example: Domani devo partire molto presto.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: to leave for somewhere
Travel|Beginner.translation: Tomorrow I have to leave very early.

Travel|Beginner.example: A che ora pensi di arrivare a Milano?
Travel|Beginner.meaning: to reach a place
Travel|Beginner.translation: What time do you think you'll get to Milan?

Travel|Beginner.example: Gira a destra dopo il semaforo.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: the right-hand side
Travel|Beginner.translation: Turn right after the traffic light.

Travel|Beginner.example: La farmacia è sulla sinistra.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: the left-hand side
Travel|Beginner.translation: The pharmacy is on the left.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Ho una prenotazione a nome Rossi.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a booking made in advance
Travel|Intermediate.translation: I have a reservation under the name Rossi.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Ho perso la coincidenza per Napoli.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a connecting flight or train
Travel|Intermediate.translation: I missed my connection to Naples.

Travel|Intermediate.example: L'imbarco comincia al gate ventuno.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the act of boarding a plane or ship
Travel|Intermediate.translation: Boarding starts at gate twenty-one.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Posso portare questo zaino come bagaglio a mano?
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the small bag you carry onto the plane
Travel|Intermediate.translation: Can I take this backpack as hand luggage?

Travel|Intermediate.example: Alla dogana ci hanno controllato le valigie.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the border office that checks what you bring in
Travel|Intermediate.translation: At customs they checked our suitcases.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Il nostro volo ha due ore di ritardo.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a delay past the scheduled time
Travel|Intermediate.translation: Our flight is two hours late.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Vorrei un biglietto andata e ritorno per Venezia.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a return trip, there and back
Travel|Intermediate.translation: I'd like a round-trip ticket to Venice.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Il treno parte dal binario sette.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the platform track where a train stops
Travel|Intermediate.translation: The train leaves from platform seven.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Ricordati di convalidare il biglietto prima di salire.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: to stamp a ticket before travelling
Travel|Intermediate.translation: Remember to validate your ticket before getting on.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Vogliamo noleggiare una macchina per il fine settimana.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: to rent a vehicle for a short time
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We want to rent a car for the weekend.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Il prezzo comprende il pernottamento e la colazione.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: an overnight stay
Travel|Intermediate.translation: The price includes the overnight stay and breakfast.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Abbiamo scelto la mezza pensione per risparmiare.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a hotel deal with breakfast and one meal
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We chose half board to save money.

Travel|Intermediate.example: L'hotel si trova nel centro storico.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the old historic part of a town
Travel|Intermediate.translation: The hotel is in the old town.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Segui il cartello per l'uscita dell'autostrada.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a road or street sign
Travel|Intermediate.translation: Follow the sign for the motorway exit.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Abbiamo pagato il pedaggio con la carta.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the fee you pay to use a motorway
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We paid the toll by card.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Temo di smarrire i documenti durante il viaggio.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: to lose something by accident
Travel|Intermediate.translation: I'm afraid of losing my documents during the trip.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Conviene fare un'assicurazione di viaggio.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a policy that covers you if something goes wrong
Travel|Intermediate.translation: It's worth taking out travel insurance.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Chiedi informazioni allo sportello delle informazioni.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a service counter or window
Travel|Intermediate.translation: Ask for information at the information desk.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Prendiamo il traghetto per l'isola alle sei.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a boat that carries people and cars across water
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We're taking the ferry to the island at six.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Domani c'è uno sciopero dei mezzi pubblici.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a work stoppage that can block transport
Travel|Intermediate.translation: Tomorrow there's a public transport strike.
